description.short: Daily speaking practice, event prep, role-play and a live cue card.
description.full: Plainspoken helps you speak clearly at work. Run a 20-minute daily routine, prep any meeting, webinar, panel, briefing or interview with a one-page brief and introduction, score your answers for pace, fillers and structure, rehearse with role-play, and deliver with a live cue card and filler counter. Built with civil service and public sector situations in mind; an independent personal project, free for personal and not-for-profit use.
